notes.title: Major Project Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I am back after a long pause. There haven't been any updates for quite some time. I've been hardly working on the project, adding new features, and fixing bugs here and there. (Yes, Even in a small project, you can encounter a lot of them! :D)

Now, you might be wondering about the release date of the game.
Well, here's the thing...

In March of this year, I invested in a new and significantly better PC. However, I managed to lose all of the game files I had before. As a result, I had to start from scratch, which might sound easy, But considering the numerous levels and various mechanics that were already in place, it took a considerable amount of time and effort to recreate. Balancing this with my regular job, which demands my time, and not being able to work on it full-time on the game slowed down the process. Additionally, I had to put a halt to creating new videos for my personal YouTube channel. (The channel was initially set up to provide financial support for my game development journey in the long run :D.) I also had to pause the creation of marketing materials for the game.

However, it's not all bad news. This situation slowly getting better. While recreating the game, I acquired new assets, enhanced the graphics, and added a lot of details to enhance the overall experience.

Regrettably, the story doesn't end here. There's still a lot that needs my attention and that I'll be working on, in the near future. (I'm optimistic that I'll be able to release the game sometime in the middle of next year :))). )

But for now, since the major groundwork has been laid, I can finally resume producing new videos on YouTube. I'll also begin the gradual process of preparing marketing materials for the game's main YouTube channel and other social platforms where the game is showcased. (I would be very grateful if you could subscribe to me there!)

Thank you for your support and patience.

Looking forward to updating you soon. :)))
